title: 10-Year Treasury Note auction (January reopening) — the leg where the SOMA add-on stops being a statistic and becomes arithmetic
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), re-fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes), the four FlateDecode content streams inflated page by page and rows rebuilt from Tm coordinates independently of the proposal that discovered this event. The row reads verbatim `10-Year NOTE / R / Thursday, January 07, 2027 / Tuesday, January 12, 2027 / Friday, January 15, 2027`, with the page legend `R --denotes reopening`, so this sells more of an existing security. 1:00pm ET is Treasury standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2027-01-07 coupon announcement. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-09 by this event's own never-assessed initial research, which read `proposals/treasury-10y-note-2027-01-12.from-treasury-10y-note-2026-12-08.json` (the only proposal for this id) in full first per EVENT-RESEARCH.md. The date, the `R` reopening read and the Friday 2027-01-15 settlement all reproduce against a fresh page-by-page fetch of the same primary. THE PROPOSAL'S FRAME IS REPLACED, NOT REFINED. It filed this event as the `cycle-position CONTROL` for the December leg's SOMA finding, on the split NEW 35/35 add-ons mean $12.35B / FIRST reopening 16/35 mean $0.85B / SECOND reopening 27/35 mean $2.70B. That split is real and it is a proxy for something exact. THE ADD-ON IS ARITHMETIC, AND BOTH ITS INPUTS ARE ALREADY PUBLISHED. `auctions_query` carries a field the sibling ledgers never used, `soma_holdings` — SOMA's holdings maturing on the auction's SETTLEMENT date — and it is identical across every coupon leg settling the same day. Three laws, each verified this session against primaries. (1) THE SPLIT IS EXACTLY PRO-RATA BY OFFERING AMOUNT, independent of how much is rolled: 2026-01-15 hold $34.64B -> 3-Year $16.88B / 10-Year $11.35B / 30-Year $6.40B = 48.75% / 32.77% / 18.48% against offering sizes $58B / $39B / $22B = 48.74% / 32.77% / 18.49%; 2026-07-15 and 2024-10-15 reproduce it to the same three decimals, the last of those on a partial roll. (2) THE ROLL RATIO IS NOW 100.0%, and it is dated: across every coupon settlement 2024-01 to date the rolled share ran 0-64% through 2024, 61-93% through 2025, and has been EXACTLY 100.0% for all 16 non-zero coupon settlements since 2025-12-31. (3) THE MATURING POOL IS PUBLISHED FOUR MONTHS EARLY. NY Fed SOMA holdings (markets.newyorkfed.org, as of 2026-09-02, HTTP 200, 433 lines) show exactly two securities maturing 2027-01-15, both TIPS — 912810PS1 ($5.61B par + $3.68B inflation compensation) and 912828V49 ($12.24B + $4.68B) — totalling $26.21B, with no coupon maturing 2026-12-15 at all. The method validates out of sample: the same file dated 2026-07-01 gives $12.34B maturing 2026-07-15 against Treasury's own $12.38B, a 0.3% gap that is accretion between as-of and settlement. SO THE EXPECTED 10-YEAR ADD-ON IS ~$8.6B AND TOTAL ACCEPTED ~$47.6B, not the $2.70B a second-reopening average would carry. THE OCTOBER CASE FALSIFIES THE CYCLE-POSITION READING OUTRIGHT: October is a second reopening and its add-on runs mean $0.64B (4/8 positive) against January $3.44B, April $3.35B, July $3.14B — because SOMA held $8.61B and $2.87B maturing on 2024-10-15 and 2025-10-15. Position is a proxy for the maturity calendar; the maturity calendar is the thing. A FREE EARLY TEST OF THE MECHANISM, 35 DAYS BEFORE THIS EVENT: the December sibling registered its add-on as a CEILING of $1.26B. SOMA holds no coupon maturing 2026-12-15 — only bill 912797WF0, $11.88B, and maturing bills roll into bills (proved on 2026-01-15, where the $7.79B bill block and the $34.64B coupon block were reported separately by Treasury). So 2026-12-08's add-on should print exactly $0.00B; registered as FT-treasury-10y-note-2027-01-12-7. THE FOMC QUESTION DOES NOT TRANSFER, WHICH IS THE HONEST DEFLATION OF `control`: the January 10-Year has been >=14 days from the nearest scheduled decision in 18 of 18 years since 2009 (D-14 to D+21), and 2027-01-12 sits D-15 from a 2027-01-26/27 meeting that carries NO asterisk on federalreserve.gov's calendar, so no dot plot. This leg is a member of the December ledger's own n=191 `>=5 days from any decision` cohort — it anchors that comparison rather than testing it. THE CORRIDOR INVERTS THE DECEMBER LEDGER'S CENTRAL RISK FINDING. December carried 28 tracked entries within +/-5 days, six of them high, with FOMC 12-09, CPI 12-10 and the funding deadline 12-11 all inside a 7-day settlement window. January carries 7 entries, one high (ISM Services 2027-01-07, before the auction), and its settlement window is 3 calendar days, Tuesday 01-12 to Friday 01-15 — the tightest in the family. The tape agrees: the January auction-to-settlement |10-Year move| runs 6.3bp mean (n=18) against December's 9.5bp (n=17), all-auction 8.3bp (n=214) and a 9.0bp ordinary five-session base rate, on 4,423 sessions of Treasury par-curve data 2009-2026. EXPECTED SIZE, per the grid rather than any published document: $39B, the 24th consecutive $39B reopening since 2024-03-12 (20 cleared, bid-to-cover mean 2.555, sigma 0.089, range 2.34-2.70). Published 2027-01-07. STRUCTURE: 3-Year Monday 01-11, this leg Tuesday 01-12, 30-Year WEDNESDAY 01-13, all settling Friday 01-15 — a compressed Mon/Tue/Wed shape against December's Mon/Tue/Thu, bracketed by New Year's Day Friday 2027-01-01 and MLK Monday 2027-01-18, both in the PDF's own holiday lines. A 6-Week bill also auctions 01-12 and the 17-/4-/8-week bills are announced that day, so this is not the session's sole supply event. ONE CORRECTION TO A SIBLING, small and non-load-bearing: the December ledger calls 2025-12-09's 8.8% dealer take `the lowest dealer share in the era`; it is the fourth lowest of 20 — 2025-09-10 4.2%, 2026-01-12 5.8%, 2026-07-08 7.8%. Its conclusion is untouched. TWO DATED ADJACENCIES PROPOSED IN THIS PR, both named-and-not-filed by the December sibling: `treasury-coupon-announcement-2027-01-07` (the primary that publishes this auction's size and settles four of this ledger's forward tests) and `treasury-3y-note-2027-01-11`. The January 30-Year 01-13 already exists as a proposal. bls.gov 403s this runner, so no January CPI or jobs date is proposed — recorded in the ledger's probe-ref.blocked rather than substituted. Reading it, not trading it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. Ledger: docs/research/events/treasury-10y-note-2027-01-12.md
